gateInviteHeadline: Enter your access code to join the Alpha.
gateInviteSubtitle: Enter the access code from your email, then complete I-Day and log your first workout.
cineWeekTitle: A logged set is a new plan.
cineWeekLead: Miss a day, travel, only a band — the week reshapes from the log. Not from a wearable, not from a schedule you already broke.
cineWeekWhy: Wednesday was a gym squat. You logged travel. The session became a hotel-room push-up. The week did not fail.
cineAnywhereTitle: Garage. Hotel carpet. A park at dusk.
cineAnywhereLead: Sets save on the device. Signal is optional. The plan comes from what you logged, so nothing needs charging for it to work.
cineLater: Mission Winning Health. Later: an athlete page you author. Not a feed.
offlineBody: This page isn't cached yet, but everything you've already used keeps working — your workouts live on this device and sync when you're back online.
